meta.about: A `move` that is not a move: the refusal names the whole set, the model corrects itself, and the deck lands. Turn 2 reads the slide on screen to prove it actually moved.
meta.recorded-outcome: asked for "next slide" on slide 15, Gemma emitted go_to_slide({"move": "16"}) — the right destination in the wrong argument. The deck did not move and the turn was over: `Can't move "16".` named no alternative and carried no `retry`, so nothing asked the model again.
meta.guards: two replies for one ask. Drop `retry: true` from go_to_slide's refusal, or narrow `retryable()` back to candidates-only, and this turn consumes one reply — reported as an unused reply AND as one call where two were expected.
